owner_direction: Follow the reviewed recommendations; keep Body War as a reference application; update ontology and import records without restoring historical evidence.

decisions.product_baseline: Current Product capabilities, component bindings and scoped local qualification describe Craft. Compiler baseline @10 remains an internal compiler input only.
decisions.generation: Generation and exact artifact observation are separate from runtime or production correctness.
decisions.integration: Binding formation supplies no provider, distributed atomicity, durable dispatch or recovery guarantee. Unknown effects remain explicit.
decisions.body_war: Body War remains a reference application. The complete current no-effect suite passes 33 Node and 16 Python tests plus contract/static validators using an explicit current test-toolchain dependency contract. No image readiness, live workload, restoration or commissioning result is inferred.
decisions.ontology: Native authored current source records feed the Lifecycle application; named outputs are derived on demand. No old saved generated graph or receipt is used as current source proof.
decisions.governance: Current D65 prototype-first construction definition and schema are referenced. Candidate construction inventories are not registered, admitted, approved or activated.

excluded_inputs: old generated DomainSpec project/profile/graph/system-ontology snapshots and projection receipt
source_pin_policy: Source choices and claims reviewed under the explicit owner instruction; selected current functional source hashes are pinned. Reconciliation detects later changes and never refreshes semantic pins automatically.
open_questions: General capability and reference-application runtime qualification remain separate from current source and reader checks.
